Report a bug

Open the relevant repository from its project page, then use Issues if enabled. Include the tool and version, Windows version, what you expected, what happened, and steps to reproduce it. Redact tokens, keys, personal paths, and private data from screenshots and logs.

Common questions

The app won’t start

Extract the whole ZIP into a new folder and check the project’s runtime requirements. Keep bundled support folders beside the executable. Use its diagnostic launcher when provided, and send the error text with your report.

Windows shows an unknown publisher

Some packages are unsigned. Check the release notes and integrity instructions for your exact file. Do not disable system protections; ask for help if you cannot establish the download’s origin.

Flipper Zero won’t connect

Use a USB data cable, close other serial tools such as qFlipper, select the correct port, then identify the device and run the workspace support check. See Flipper Studio’s quick-start guide.

Where are new releases?

Use the Downloads page and project repositories. Development milestones are not download announcements.
